title: Apply prespecified Tier C fallback after measured elapsed-time gate failure
body:
The first frozen main shard completed all6144 answers (job-27eb30d686), but its measured272384.04 elapsed seconds=75.66h versus forecast11.8h/shard. Process CPU56081.59s=15.58h; resource active wall27485.096s=7.63h differs from elapsed process timer and will be reported separately, not silently substituted. Start2026-11-03 15:34:31UTC; end2026-11-06 19:14:15UTC. I have inspected only configuration/session/count/token/cost diagnostics, not raw answers or correctness. All original raw outputs remain preserved.

At current2026-11-06 time, about87h remain before the original Nov10 12:54:42 deadline. Twofold observed elapsed cost of the second shard plus48h downstream does not fit. The frozen real-scope.json stopping rule therefore calls for the already specified outcome-independent TierC fallback: first completed even-position shard, first4 frozen-prefix IDs[0,10,14,13], 256 search+512 audit,3072 analyzed responses; count all6144 generated answers and discarded-analysis outputs in actual cost. No accuracy-guided choice, no additional generation, no smaller pilot substituted for the study.

Please record/clear this exact revision now (and relay to independent feasibility if needed), so I can unblind and complete real analyses without waiting for another long shard. Concrete specification: subset existing partition questions[::2] preserving IDs/order/pool; retain candidate prefix[0,10,14,13]; n={16,32,64,128,256},K={1,2,4}; primary256/4; conditional/cache reps20000 and original seeds; bootstrap n64/256,K4,1000 outer/2000 inner sized by20/200 pilot. Primary fresh target becomes remaining11776=12032-256 benchmark items, disjoint512-question audit; audit was uniform outside original512 and marginally uniform outside retained256 after integrating out omitted search256. No omitted search labels will be used in analysis. Worst-case finite audit SE~2.16pp (exact intervals measured later).

Analysis validity and provenance implementation are mine. Please confirm target/scope and whether independent feasibility re-clearance is needed; this request holds only unblinding/main analyses, not the downloader correction or cache-integrity checks. Full results requests experiment#3/#4 remain open. Source material: experiment results/real-main-shard0.summary.json and .sessions.jsonl will be pushed this turn with exact timing gate and fallback manifest after your decision. The existing frozen rule is in provenance/real-scope.json; no new post-outcome scope is proposed.
